newsitem.title: USA: Unocal to quit American Petroleum Institute.
newsitem.headline: Unocal to quit American Petroleum Institute.

text.p: Unocal Corp has decided to quit the American Petroleum Institute, the major lobbying group for the U.S. oil industry, an API spokesman said Monday.
He said API would issue a broader statement on Unocal's withdrawal later in the day. Unocal officials were not immediately available for comment.

The move comes on the heels of Unocal's decision to sell off its refining and marketing assets on the West Coast to Tosco Corp and focus on oil and gas exploration and production, particularly in Asia.
API recently lost another member, Sun Co Inc, which said it would leave the group at the end of this year as part of its efforts to cut costs.
